1.consolidated_definition: (T. en Col., Ecuad., Hond., Méx., Perú y Ven.). Sirve para denotar que una cosa es difícil o imposible de realizar. Creyeron que yo iba a darle el dinero, pero ¡cuando!
1.en_consolidated_definition: (Term used in Colombia, Ecuador, Honduras, Mexico, Peru and Venezuela.) Serves to indicate that something is difficult or impossible to accomplish. They thought I was going to give him the money, but when!
